page.body:
FAQ (MLS & CRM)


PropertyList.es MLS & CRM: Frequently Asked Questions


Does Propertylist.es require a credit card to join?

No, a form of payment is NOT required to join. Only if you want to buy credits.


Is PropertyList.es free to use?

Yes, PropertyList.es is FREE to use with paid features within the system that are optional.


What are the benefits of using PropertyList.es?

For Freelancers: 

PropertyList.es allows freelancers to share their listings at no cost. This cost-efficient approach is especially helpful for those starting out in the industry.
  - For Agencies: 
Agencies can freely share their properties with a wide audience. Additionally, they can manage staff accounts, listings, events, and documents—all in one place.
  - For Developers: 
Listing new developments for free on PropertyList.es helps developers reach thousands of agents and buyers. It also facilitates connections with property services that may prove valuable.
  - For Property Services: 
We welcome all services related to property, connect with estate agents, developers, and property seekers, expanding your network and business opportunities.
  - For Buyers/Renters:
Extensive Property Listings: PropertyList.es aggregates a wide range of properties, making it easier for buyers and renters to find their ideal home or investment.
Agent Expertise: Buyers and renters can benefit from the expertise of real estate agents associated with the platform. Agents can guide them through the process, answer questions, and provide insights.
Advanced Search Filters: Users can filter properties based on specific criteria (such as location, price range, amenities, etc.), saving time and effort.


What is an MLS & CRM?

Multiple Listing Service (MLS): This is a platform specifically designed for real estate agents to share information and collaborate on listings. PropertyList.es facilitates this agent-to-agent communication, allowing agents to expose their listings to a wider pool of potential buyers and renters represented by other agents on the platform totally FREE!


Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

This is a software that helps agents manage their interactions with clients. PropertyList.es’ CRM features help agents track leads, manage communications, and stay organised throughout the sales or rental process.


What is PropertyList.es?

PropertyList.es is a full-service solution for real estate agents in Spain. It functions as both a Multiple Listing Service (MLS), a Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Public faceing Property Portal and Lead Generation platform.


How can I access property market data on PropertyList.es?

Coming Soon – PropertyList.es provides access to valuable market data, including trends, comparative analysis tools, and insights into buyer preferences.


Can I link/add properties to a contact’s profile?

Yes, PropertyList.es allows you to link properties to contacts. Learn how to do this here.

How do I list a property on PropertyList.es?

You’ll need to be a registered agent with a PropertyList.es account. The specific listing process can be found here.

How can I assign a contact to a specific agent?

PropertyList.es allows you to assign contacts to agents for streamlined communication and task management. Learn how to assign your contact a staff member here.


Can I add professional contacts to a client’s profile?

Yes, PropertyList.es allows you to link professional contacts (lawyers, architects, etc.) to your client’s profile. You can specify the type of professional relationship for better organization. Learn more here.

How do I sign up for PropertyList.es?

Sign up for FREE here. (NO credit card information required, ever!)

Not signed up yet? Get a FREE account and connect with agents throughout Andalucía. Streamline collaboration and close more deals.
